title: Vibe code this simple iOS game with the help of google gemini studio. Would you guys play this game with your friends?
author: Muted_Disaster4187
selftext: Recently with the help of Google ai studio I built a local multiplayer game that challenges players to test their speed and reflexes. The objective is simple: mash your button faster than your opponent to pull the rope to your side in a classic Tug of War.

comments.author: odragora
comments.body:
If it's just pressing a single button as fast as possible, then it's not really a game, because there is no decision making involved and no interaction with the opponent. More like a toy.

To make it compelling to play you would need to make it so that the players can outplay each other by making better decisions (deciding when to press the button) and adapting to the opponent (some kind of a rock-paper-scissors dynamic).

replies.author: Muted_Disaster4187
replies.body: That's a helpful advice. I am a new to this. But I am gonna keep this in mind when I create a new game. Thanks a lot for giving me this perspective.
